cues.text: A sunny seaside promenade. A boy in a black school uniform walks alone.
The hero settles his headphones.
He scrolls his music player to a song: Full Moon Full Life.
In stark blue and white, he walks down a back alley, hands in his pockets.
Blue butterflies swirl.
A city of blue blocks, from far above.
A schoolgirl leaps from a tall building.
A girl in a pink cardigan puts on lipstick at a mirror.
A young man in a black cap grins.
A red-haired girl races a motorcycle down an empty highway.
On a train, three boys sit apart, silent.
The sky turns green. A giant clock looms over red water.
A boy on a sofa raises a pistol to his head.
In a blue room, a man bows by a framed contract.
One by one, young fighters put pistols to their heads. Huge spirits burst out behind them.
Red shrine gates line a stone stairway. A white dog sits at the top.
On a rooftop, a girl stands alone by a wind turbine.
A long-haired man at a wall of monitors.
The hero falls past a huge yellow moon. A winged shadow fills it.
The moon thins to a crescent. Red drips into a pool.
A red-haired girl with a machine body kneels. Cards scatter around her.
A mechanical eye closes.
A robot girl in a glowing capsule.
Smiling faces flash by, and a white dog.
The hero stands tall, the silhouettes of friends behind him.
Title: Persona 3 Reload.
